text:
ashley: Kicking off phased rollout for v2.3.1 · US -> EU -> APAC. Window 02:00-05:00 UTC. Pinning strategy: US full, EU canary 10% -> 50% if green, APAC warm pool only. ops please confirm capacity.

deploy-bot: Started canary in US region (slice-a). Canary ID: c-2498765300. Routing: 10% traffic. Logs: https://deploys/reports/c-2498765300

sam: I can run the US smoke tests now. Running quick p99 latency and model-throughput checks.

sre-bot: Canary live metrics: errors 0.4%, p95 latency 210ms, GPU util 62%.

julia: Confirming token budget — US reserved pool has 15% cushion for burst, should be fine. EU reserved is tight (5% cushion).

kevin: If EU is tight, plan to start EU canary at 5% and hold for 30m. If latency > 350ms or errors > 1% over a 10m window, we'll pin EU back to v2.2.9 automatically.

mohit: Noting rollback trigger: automated rule -> `errors > 1% for 10m` OR `p95 > 450ms for 5m`. Ops will validate alert thresholds.

ashley: Updated rollout doc in release notes: https://confluence/releases/v2.3.1 - includes rollback steps and canary IDs. Tagging @kevin @julia for EU holdpoint.

julia: EU canary scheduled to start at 02:40 UTC. I'll manually approve increase to 50% after 30m if metrics look good.

deploy-bot: EU canary started (slice-b) at 02:40 UTC. Canary ID: c-2498765380. Monitoring link: https://deploys/reports/c-2498765380

sre-bot: EU metrics 10m in: errors 0.9%, p95 380ms, GPU util 78%. Not ideal but within soft threshold. Recommend hold at 10% and re-evaluate at +20m.

kevin: Holding EU at 10%. If errors spike to >1.2% or p95 climbs above 420ms we'll pin immediately and open rollback.

ashley: APAC will receive no production traffic yet — warm pool only. Coming back in 40m for final go/no-go.

sam: US post-canary check: all smoke tests passed, p50/p95 stable. Approving US full rollout.

deploy-bot: US roll progressing to 100% over 15m window. Rollout ID: r-2498765400

sre-bot: US final metrics at 15m: errors 0.3%, p95 225ms. No incidents.

ashley: Thanks team. Leaving EU holdpoint until 03:15 UTC. If still acceptable, will increase to 50% then proceed to APAC warm->traffic.

julia: Copy. Monitoring dashboard pinned; will post final status at 03:15.

kevin: If anything weird, rollback command is:
```
deployctl rollback --region eu --to-version v2.2.9 --reason "canary threshold breach"
```

ashley: Great — callout: update to on-call phone tree if rollback happens. I'm standing by until 04:00 UTC. :eyes:

deploy-bot: Rollout r-2498765400 completed for US at 02:58 UTC.

julia: EU still within thresholds at 03:15: errors 0.95%, p95 390ms. Incrementing to 50% now.

deploy-bot: EU traffic slice scaled to 50% (slice-b). New canary checkpoint c-2498765420.

sre-bot: EU 10m after scale: errors 1.4% — exceeding alert. Initiating automated pin to v2.2.9 and notifying channel.

deploy-bot: Automated action: pinning routes in EU back to v2.2.9. Action ID: a-2498765440. Rolling back canary.

kevin: Confirming rollback executed. Opening post-rollback incident channel for analysis. Tagging infra and runtime teams.

ashley: Ok, EU rollback done. APAC stay in warm pool. Will file postmortem tomorrow. Thanks for fast reactions.

sam: Capturing notes for changelog and follow-up tests. Will add perf-run targeting EU models tomorrow.

ashley: Thread closed for now — follow-ups in #postmortems. :lock:
